limitations_and_boundaries: MN disruption frequency was assessed in a limited set of cell lines; generalizability to all cell types is not established.
The study focuses on lagging chromosomes giving rise to whole-chromosome MN; broken-chromosome MN were not separately analyzed in depth.
The mechanism of LmnB1 depletion in MN is not fully elucidated.
The role of MN disruption in chromothripsis is correlative and not directly demonstrated.
Tumor analysis was limited to NSCLC; applicability to other solid tumors remains to be tested.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

incorrect_items.description: The claim states 'MN disruption is caused by NE collapse, not NPC loss.' The source excerpt in the claim's provenance is 'the loss of compartmentalization in disrupted MN was the result of NPC loss', which is the opposite of the claim. The source text actually says: 'We first asked whether the loss of compartmentalization in disrupted MN was the result of NPC loss. We examined the levels of NPC components in intact and disrupted MN by immunofluorescence and found that the core nucleoporins recognized by mAb414 are present at similar levels in both disrupted and intact MN (Figures S2A and S2B), suggesting that a loss of NPC proteins is not driving compartmentalization loss.' Thus, the claim is contradicted by the source.

methods.name: Time-lapse fluorescence microscopy
methods.protocol_description: U2OS cells expressing fluorescent reporters were imaged on a Zeiss Axioscope/Yokagawa spinning disk confocal microscope with 63x/1.4NA oil or 20x/0.8NA air objectives at 37°C and 10% CO2. Images captured with EM CCD camera using AxioVision software.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence
methods.protocol_description: Cells fixed in 4% PFA in PBS for 10 min at RT, blocked in 3% BSA in PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100, incubated with primary and secondary antibodies, stained with DAPI, and mounted in Vectashield.

methods.name: Cell synchronization by mitotic shake-off
methods.protocol_description: Cells incubated in 100 ng/ml nocodazole for up to 6 hr, then mitotic cells collected by shake-off onto coverslips in fresh medium.

methods.name: EdU pulse-labeling
methods.protocol_description: EdU added to medium at 10 µM for pulse-labeling to identify S phase cells.

methods.name: Drug treatments for cell cycle arrest
methods.protocol_description: Hydroxyurea (HU) at 2 mM for S phase arrest; RO-3306 (Cdk1 inhibitor) at 10 µM for G2 arrest.
